title.zh: Evernorth与Armada Acquisition Corp. II合并获批并完成，将以XRPN在纳斯达克上市
title.en: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut

current_state.zh: 由Ripple支持的Evernorth已完成与Armada Acquisition Corp. II的SPAC合并，将于10月12日在纳斯达克开始交易，股票代码为XRPN，持有约4.73亿枚XRP，并从包括Ripple、SBI Group、Pantera Capital、Kraken和GSR在内的投资者处获得约3亿美元的总现金收益，而其会计模型在确认减值损失后，不允许在XRP回升时进行转回。
current_state.en: Ripple-backed Evernorth completed its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN on October 12, carrying roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds from investors including Ripple, SBI Group, Pantera Capital, Kraken and GSR, while its accounting model recognizes impairment losses without allowing reversals when XRP recovers.

updates.title_en: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
updates.what_changed_zh: Evernorth 预计合并将于 10 月 7 日完成，股票随后一天在纳斯达克以股票代码 XRPN 开始交易，交易预计筹集约 3 亿美元总现金收益。
updates.what_changed_en: Evernorth expects the merger to close on Oct. 7, with shares set to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN the following day, and the transaction expected to raise about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.current_state_zh: Armada Acquisition Corp. II 股东已批准与 Evernorth 的合并；该交易预计于 2026 年 10 月 7 日完成，合并后公司预计随后在纳斯达克以代码 XRPN 开始交易，但仍待剩余交割条件满足。
updates.current_state_en: Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholders approved the merger with Evernorth; the deal is expected to close on Oct. 7, 2026, with the combined company set to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN the following day, subject to remaining closing conditions.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Evernorth shareholders approved its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, setting up a Nasdaq debut under ticker XRPN with a 473 million XRP treasury valued at about $710 million.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Evernorth shareholders approved its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, setting up a Nasdaq debut under ticker XRPN with a 473 million XRP treasury valued at about $710 million.

updates.title_en: XRP财库公司Evernorth完成与SPAC合并，10月12日登陆纳斯达克，持有4.73亿枚XRP
updates.what_changed_zh: Evernorth 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的合并，并宣布将于 10 月 12 日在纳斯达克以 XRPN 开始交易；交易完成后持有约 4.73 亿枚 XRP 及约 3 亿美元现金总收益。
updates.what_changed_en: Evernorth completed its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and announced it will begin trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on Oct. 12; after closing it holds roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.current_state_zh: Evernorth 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的合并，预计于 2026 年 10 月 12 日在纳斯达克以代码 XRPN 开始交易；公司持有约 4.73 亿枚 XRP 和约 3 亿美元现金总收益。
updates.current_state_en: Evernorth has completed its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and is set to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN on Oct. 12, 2026; it holds roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: XRP treasury firm Evernorth Holdings completed its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.detailed_summary_en: XRP treasury firm Evernorth Holdings completed its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.background_zh: SPAC 即“空白支票公司”，是通过 IPO 募集资金的已上市壳公司，需在特定期限内收购一家私人公司或与之合并，合并正是目标公司实现上市的方式。Evernorth 此前已向 SEC 递交文件，推进纳斯达克上市进程，并与基础设施服务商 t54 合作管理其 XRP 财库。
updates.background_en: A SPAC, or blank-check company, is a listed shell that raises money through an IPO in order to acquire or merge with a private company within a set timeframe; the merger is how the target becomes publicly listed. Evernorth had earlier filed with the SEC as it moved toward a Nasdaq listing, and has worked with infrastructure provider t54 on managing its XRP treasury.
updates.market_impact_zh: XRPN 为机构和公开市场投资者提供了一只以 XRP 计价的财库与收益策略载体，其传导路径主要通过股票市场准入、托管与 XRP 增持，而非交易所层面的整体流动性。该事件也关系到更广泛的上市数字资产财库公司群体，这些公司正在争夺同一批机构资金。
updates.market_impact_en: XRPN gives institutional and public-market investors a listed vehicle whose treasury and yield strategies are denominated in XRP, so the transmission path runs through equity-market access, custody and XRP accumulation rather than through exchange-wide liquidity. The story is also relevant to the broader segment of listed digital-asset treasury companies competing for the same institutional capital.
